factor_definitions.sports_meaning: A play carrying a source-structured penalty indicator.
A penalty with canonical structured status accepted; accepted no-play is a separate factor.
A penalty with canonical structured status declined.
A penalty with canonical structured status accepted_no_play; the global event-eligibility gate may correctly leave this as DATA_GAP for market inference.
A replay or challenge whose final structured result is reversed.
A source-structured replay or challenge episode.
A source-structured team timeout.
The pre-snap yards-to-go is strictly greater than ten.
A score in overtime or inside the final five minutes with the pre-event margin at most eight.
A finalized turnover episode with pre-event yardline at or inside the opponent twenty.
A failed third- or fourth-down attempt.
A registered explosive play using the frozen sport definition.
A source-structured first down.
A fourth-down play awarded a structured first down; nullified episodes are excluded by the global event-eligibility gate.
A fumble with a non-null source-structured first-recovery team; fumbles without a recorded recovery are intentionally outside this factor.
A quarterback kneel play.
A live play with negative yards gained.
A source-structured pass play.
A source-structured rush play excluding quarterback kneels.
A source-structured sack.
A source-structured quarterback scramble.
A quarterback spike.
A play marked successful by the frozen nflverse success definition.
The focal-team last actual pre-event trade is above 0.67.
The focal-team last actual pre-event trade is below 0.33.
The focal-team last actual pre-event trade is within 0.33 through 0.67.
The last actual pre-event trade is no more than five seconds old in source time.
The last actual pre-event trade is more than five and at most thirty seconds old.
The last actual pre-event trade is more than thirty and at most sixty seconds old.
A non-null roster-set difference observed between adjacent participation rows; this is not an exact substitution timestamp or reason.
The participating quarterback entered kickoff with positive trailing-eight CPOE.
The participating quarterback entered kickoff with positive trailing-eight EPA per dropback.
The participating receiver entered kickoff with trailing-eight target share of at least twenty percent.
The participating rusher entered kickoff with positive trailing-eight EPA per attempt.
A finalized defensive two-point conversion.
A source-structured defensive two-point attempt, regardless of conversion result.
A blocked field-goal attempt.
A made field goal.
A missed field goal that was not blocked.
A passing touchdown in the finalized scoring episode.
A point-after attempt with source result blocked.
A made point-after attempt inside a finalized touchdown episode.
A point-after attempt with source result failed and not blocked.
A kickoff, punt, interception, or fumble return touchdown.
A rushing touchdown in the finalized scoring episode.
An offensive two-point try with source result failure inside a finalized touchdown episode.
A successful offensive two-point try inside a finalized touchdown episode.
The next scoring drive answers the opponent's immediately preceding score.
Two finalized turnover episodes occur consecutively without an intervening score.
A blocked kick is followed by a structured return or score in the same finalized episode.
A finalized live episode in overtime.
A drive entered the red zone and ended without points.
A finalized live play is followed by a review that reverses the ruling.
A touchdown episode finalized together with its PAT or two-point try.
A drive is active inside the final two minutes of a half.
A kickoff carrying the source-structured out-of-bounds indicator.
A kickoff recovered by the kicking team according to the source-structured own-recovery indicator.
A source play typed kickoff with strictly positive structured return yards; zero or negative returns are excluded rather than inferred.
A kickoff resulting in a touchback.
A source-structured punt play.
A punt carrying the source-structured blocked indicator.
A punt carrying the source-structured downed indicator.
A punt carrying the source-structured fair-catch indicator.
A punt downed or returned with source inside-twenty indicator.
A punt carrying the source-structured out-of-bounds indicator.
A punt with strictly positive structured return yards.
A source-structured punt play with a touchback indicator.
A source-structured safety.
The pre-snap yards-to-go is strictly greater than ten.
The pre-snap yards-to-go is from four through seven.
The pre-snap yards-to-go is at most three.
The pre-snap yards-to-go is from eight through ten.
The focal offense is in opponent territory outside the red zone.
The focal offense is in its own territory.
The focal offense is at or inside the opponent twenty.
More than thirty regulation minutes remain.
At most five regulation minutes remain.
More than five and at most fifteen regulation minutes remain.
More than fifteen and at most thirty regulation minutes remain.
The pre-play state is goal-to-go.
The absolute focal-team pre-event score margin is one through eight.
The absolute focal-team pre-event score margin is greater than eight.
The pre-event score is tied.
The event occurs in the first quarter.
The event occurs in the second quarter.
The event occurs in the third quarter.
The event occurs in the fourth quarter.
The event occurs in overtime.
The focal-team pre-play Vegas win probability is above 0.67.
The focal-team pre-play Vegas win probability is below 0.33.
The focal-team pre-play Vegas win probability is within 0.33 through 0.67.
The focal team entered kickoff with a positive trailing-eight offensive success-rate difference versus the opponent.
The focal team entered kickoff with a positive trailing-eight passing EPA-per-play difference versus the opponent.
The focal team entered kickoff with a positive trailing-eight rushing EPA-per-play difference versus the opponent.
The focal offense entered kickoff with trailing-eight sack rate above ten percent.
The focal offense entered kickoff with trailing-eight turnover rate above three percent.
A source-structured fumble lost by the focal possession team.
A source-structured interception.
A source-structured failed fourth-down attempt.
Absolute completion residual exceeds fifteen percentage points using source CP/CPOE fields.
Chosen fourth-down action WP is at least one percentage point below the best available action WP.
Absolute pass-over-expected exceeds fifteen percentage points.
Absolute post-play WP minus pre-play punt-model WP exceeds two percentage points.
Absolute YAC EPA minus XYAC EPA exceeds 0.5 EPA.
